observations: Three photos of one cream desktop photocopier, wrapped in clear plastic film, sitting on wooden pallets in a warehouse.
Photo 0: front panel reads 'SHARP AR-M207' clearly.
Photo 2: same 'SHARP AR-M207' badge from a higher angle; document cover and glass under the film.
Photo 1: side view showing a 'digital' logo, two paper trays marked A4 and A3, and an energy label; 'SHARP' badge partly visible.
All photos carry a dealer watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' and 'Posted on Jiji'; they look like stock photos from a dealer's warehouse.
Machine is never shown powered on; no control panel display, no counter, no test copy.
Plastic wrap hides surface scratches and cracks; no visible broken panels through it.

claims.evidence: Badge 'SHARP AR-M207' legible in photo 0 and photo 2.
Nothing in the photos shows origin; a UK plug or import papers would only hint at it.
No counter or configuration report shown; machine is never powered on.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: Front door is closed in every photo; no photo of the drum or toner cartridge or their life readout.
No clip of the machine copying.
Sales copy, not a checkable fact.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or does not copy cleanly.
risks.proof: Clip of the machine powering on and making a copy from the glass and from the tray, showing the printed page.

risks.risk: Page count is far higher than claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the total counter on the display or a printed configuration or counter report.

risks.risk: Drum and toner are worn or missing, not new.
risks.proof: Photo inside the open front door showing the drum and toner, plus the toner and drum life readout.
risks.if_unproven: As needing a new drum and toner.

risks.risk: Photos are dealer stock shots and not the exact unit sold.
risks.proof: Photo of this unit's serial plate next to a paper with the seller's name and today's date.
risks.if_unproven: As the worst unit of this model.

risks.risk: Cracked or missing panels, trays or document cover hidden by the wrap.
risks.proof: Photos of all sides with the wrap removed, trays pulled out.
risks.if_unproven: As fair cosmetic condition with possible missing parts.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powering on and making a copy, showing the printed page.
Photo of the counter screen or printed counter report.
Photo inside the front door of the drum and toner, with their life readout.
Photo of the serial plate with a handwritten note of the seller's name and today's date.
Photos of all sides and trays with the plastic wrap removed.
response.reason: The badge in photos 0 and 2 reads Sharp AR-M207, so the model is known and can be priced at its worst case, as not working with a high page count and worn consumables. A working copy clip, counter report and drum and toner photos would raise it.
